static_traits.name: Lin Ruoqing
static_traits.family_status: Living alone；与父母和兄弟姐妹关系亲密
static_traits.social_status: 与家人及少数密友关系Good；在工作中与顾客的互动引发Anxiety与Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗；without类似问题史
static_traits.language_features: 首次咨询略显紧张；表达清晰、条理较好；配合度高；能够自我Reflection但倾向过度分析并将反馈个人化

basic_info.main_problem: 在零售工作中觉得所有顾客都讨厌自己，导致Persistent anxiety和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts are having an ever greater impact on my work performance and mental health, therefore I am seeking counseling.
growth_experiences: 约六个月前在工作中收到几位顾客的负面评论，此后逐渐产生并加重“顾客都讨厌我”的想法。问题初期的压力水平为中等，但随着时间推移发展为每次顾客互动前都感到Significant anxiety，并在互动后反复过度分析顾客反应，认为他们可能not满意或在心里看not起自己。该问题每日多次出现，尤其While at work段；Declining sleep quality，整体Rising stress。

core_beliefs: I am not liked/让人讨厌

special_situations.event: Six months ago received several negative customer reviews
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果被顾客批评，就说明我是个not好的人，所有顾客都会讨厌我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Works hard to improve customer interaction and seeks more positive feedback

special_situations.event: Each time before interacting with customers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果顾客not立刻表现满意，必定是我做错了
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在互动前高度紧张并Over-preparation；互动后继续反复检查细节
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次他们又会not满意/会讨厌我

special_situations.event: 看到顾客出现not满或not赞同的表情
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 任何not满表情都意味着他们在责怪我这个人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Afterwards repeatedly replays and over-analyzes customers' reactions and details
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定在心里看not起我

special_situations.event: Even when customers praise and show satisfaction, the client still mainly focuses on negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only zero negative feedback counts as qualified; otherwise it is failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or belittles positive feedback and keeps focusing on negative evaluations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 好的not算数，差评才是真实

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by customers, liked, and seen as valuable
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被批评与被讨厌，从而negate自我并影响工作表现
defense_goal: 通过过度分析与Self-monitoring来避免再次被negate
Staying highly vigilant to maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被negate、需要not断证明自己的服务人员
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、易not满并可能责备自己的顾客

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当顾客出现not满表情或给出负面反馈时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将顾客的任何not满理解为对自己人格的negate（移情：把他人的想法当作对自己的评价）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气谨慎而not确定，频繁自我检讨并寻求外部保证；回避肯定自我，强调可能的错误。

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly overanalyzes customer reactions in work interactions
将负面反馈内化为对自我价值的negate
频繁Self-doubt、难以接纳正向证据

exception_events.target_problem: 在零售工作中与顾客互动时，来访者通常会在出现轻微负面反馈或not满表情后产生强烈Anxiety并过度分析，认为对方讨厌自己，进而影响工作表现。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 有许多顾客在服务结束后当场表示满意并给予称赞，来访者获得正向反馈，互动顺利，not yet出现强烈Anxiety与Self-denial。
exception_events.reason: not同证据与支持：顾客明确的正向反馈提供了与负性信念相矛盾的线索；not同做法：来访者曾主动改进客户互动，从而更易获得积极结果。

positive_force: Has a supportive family and friend network
过去获得过顾客称赞与正向反馈，表明具备Good服务能力
Positive attitude, willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
negative_force: Negative cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and overgeneralization
Over-personalizes feedback, ignoring positive evidence (mental filtering)
在每次顾客互动前后出现强烈Anxiety与Self-doubt，导致睡眠与压力问题

target_behavior.behavior: 在顾客互动前出现强烈Anxiety、互动后进行事后过度分析并Self-doubt
antecedent: 看到顾客not满或not赞同的表情
target_behavior.core_reason: Interprets negative feedback catastrophically and with mind reading, overgeneralizes, and tends to personalize the feedback.
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential criticism and rejection, seeks certainty and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance；睡眠质量变差；整体Increased stress levels；Persistent self-doubt
